sol.label: Edit profile
sol.detail: Frames 03–04 show a check beside Default and Preview app as the second option in a horizontal menu.

sol.label: Outside the diagram
sol.detail: Frames 07–08 place Button 0x01FF below the six numbered MX Master 4 rows without adding a marker. Frames 17–18 show Spare button in that same row.

sol.label: Gesture button tap
sol.detail: Frames 01–02 print Win and Tab as separate keycaps next to Task View and retain a labeled Edit control.

sol.label: Choose an action to assign now
sol.detail: Frames 01–02 repeat the amber 2 in the photo and editor title. Frames 09–10 mark Close tab with both Ctrl + W and a check.

sol.label: No matching actions
sol.detail: Frames 03–04 put Clear search and Record a keyboard shortcut under the empty result. Frames 01–02 show Copy with separate Ctrl and C keycaps.

sol.label: Switch between two pointer speeds
sol.detail: Frames 03–04 pair each numeric field with a slider and show Current: 1000 DPI and Next press: 800 DPI above Save pointer speed action.

sol.label: Press a key
sol.detail: Frames 05–06 outline the recording panel and show Stop recording. Frames 23–24 fit Ctrl + Win + Alt + Shift + Space inside the short dialog.

sol.label: Ignore accidental nudges
sol.detail: Frames 01–02 show 50% of a notch. Frames 05–06 replace the adjustment with a reminder of the saved threshold when high-resolution scrolling is off.

sol.label: Gesture recognition off
sol.detail: Frames 05–06 mute the direction icons while the action controls retain their amber pencils.

sol.label: Pick a window
sol.detail: Frames 07–08 show a six-second countdown next to the instruction with + 6 seconds and Cancel below. Frame 11 adds a python.exe chip and a confirmation.

sol.label: Edit button mappings
sol.detail: Frames 03–06 place that action below the disconnected or no-device message. Frames 09–10 keep both connection and firmware cards in view at 720 pixels wide.

sol.label: HID++ features
sol.detail: Frames 01–04 use amber monospace IDs beside names such as Adjustable DPI and wrap the 18 unnamed IDs into two lines.

sol.label: Remapping paused
sol.detail: Frames 05–06 keep the title-bar badge after the warning goes away. Frames 17–18 show Applies after resume next to Save shortcut.

sol.label: Resume remapping
sol.detail: Frame 02 uses the same second row as Pause remapping in frame 01. Both keep the check beside Start with Windows.

terra.label: Edit profile
terra.detail: The profile picker opens a two-option row above the mapping cards in 03-Dark-menu.

terra.label: Outside the diagram
terra.detail: Button 0x01FF appears in a separate card under that label in 07-Dark-extra-button.

terra.label: Gesture button tap
terra.detail: The compact list displays Win and Tab keycaps beside Task View in 01-Dark-compact.

terra.label: Choose an action to assign now
terra.detail: Categories occupy a left column and actions with shortcuts occupy the right in 01-Dark-popover.

terra.label: No matching actions
terra.detail: The empty state offers Clear search and Record a keyboard shortcut in 03-Dark-no-results.

terra.label: Switch between two pointer speeds
terra.detail: The DPI editor shows 800 and 1600, the current 1000 DPI, and the next press value in 03-Dark-dpi-editor.

terra.label: Press a key
terra.detail: The recording state has an orange outline and says Esc cancels recording in 05-Dark-seq-03-record.

terra.label: Ignore accidental nudges
terra.detail: The slider shows 50% of a notch and explains the threshold after a pause or reversal in 01-Dark-scroll.

terra.label: Minimum swipe distance
terra.detail: Five gesture rows pair directional arrows with action chips, and the slider reads 60 counts in 01-Dark-gestures.

terra.label: Pick a window
terra.detail: The capture state says to switch to the app window and displays 6s with a +6 seconds control in 07-Dark-window-pick.

terra.label: Disconnected
terra.detail: The disconnected card says saved button mappings remain editable and provides an Edit button mappings button in 03-Dark-disconnected.

terra.label: 18 unnamed features
terra.detail: The diagnostics page groups hexadecimal IDs into chips and offers Copy unnamed IDs in 01-Dark-diagnostics.

terra.label: Resume unconfirmed
terra.detail: The banner directs the user to the Windows tray and offers Hide steps in 09-Dark-resume-error.

terra.label: Pause remapping
terra.detail: The active tray menu has a checked Start with Windows item and a Quit Mushak item in 01-Windows-tray-active.

astra.label: Edit profile
astra.detail: Frames 01-04 place the profile control at top right. The open menu shows Default with a checkmark and Preview app beside it.

astra.label: Outside the diagram
astra.detail: Frames 07-08 separate Button 0x01FF below six numbered mouse controls. Frames 11-12 highlight marker 2 and the matching Back button card together.

astra.label: Windows handles left click and scrolling.
astra.detail: Frames 01-02 and 05-06 show five compact rows with keycap badges and explicit Edit buttons. The footer explains which inputs Windows handles.

astra.label: Choose an action to assign now
astra.detail: Frames 01-06 pair a close view of the thumb buttons with a category column and action list. Frames 09-10 retain the same layout in a compact dialog.

astra.label: No matching actions
astra.detail: Frames 03-04 show an empty search state with Clear search and Record a keyboard shortcut. Frames 01-02 show Copy with separate Ctrl and C keycaps.

astra.label: Save pointer speed action
astra.detail: Frames 03-04 show Speed 1 at 800 and Speed 2 at 1600, each with an input and slider. A line distinguishes Current: 1000 DPI from Next press: 800 DPI.

astra.label: Keyboard shortcut
astra.detail: Frames 09-10 mark the shortcut tab as Draft and warn that choosing an action discards draft M. Frames 19-22 show K saved and the reopened editor with a green Saved status.

astra.label: Ignore accidental nudges
astra.detail: Frames 01-04 show a 50% of a notch threshold below High-resolution scrolling. Frames 07-08 stack wheel mode choices vertically in the compact window.

astra.label: Minimum swipe distance
astra.detail: Frames 01-04 show 60 counts with an approximate 1.5 mm distance at 1000 DPI. Frames 05-06 keep actions editable while explicitly showing Gesture recognition off.

astra.label: Pick a window
astra.detail: Frames 07-08 show a six-second capture countdown with + 6 seconds and Cancel. Frames 15-16 move ordering buttons below a long profile name instead of truncating it.

astra.label: Reapply mouse settings
astra.detail: Frames 01-02 show Bluetooth, firmware MPM 12.01.B0006, a 50% battery bar, and a 1000 DPI slider. Disconnected frames 03-04 offer Edit button mappings.

astra.label: HID++ features
astra.detail: Frames 01-04 separate 11 named feature IDs in two columns from 18 unnamed feature chips, with Copy device report and Copy unnamed IDs controls.

astra.label: Resume unconfirmed
astra.detail: Frames 09-10 retain Remapping paused with Retry and show tray recovery instructions. Frames 25-26 say Copy is still unsaved and provide Try again and Back to editing.

astra.label: Resume remapping
astra.detail: Frame 01 has Pause remapping. Frame 02 changes that item to Resume remapping, while Start with Windows keeps its checkmark and Quit Mushak stays below a separator.
